terms.name: Assurance
terms.definition: Evidence-supported confidence that specified properties or outcomes will hold under stated objectives, operating conditions, and assumptions. Assurance has a defined scope and can lose relevance when those conditions change.

terms.name: Evidence laundering through AI
terms.definition: The appearance of credibility or corroboration acquired by low-integrity material when AI systems retrieve, summarize, cite, or re-present it. Multiple apparently agreeing outputs may share the same original, manipulated source.
